title: Personal Task Manager Application
summary: Complete CLI task tracking application with persistent JSON storage and formatted listings.

configuration.title: Maximum Tasks
configuration.description: Maximum number of active tasks allowed

steps.description: Initialize file persistence layer and read existing tasks JSON file
Format table rows with text padding and alignment

explanations.beginner: This application lets you track your daily to-do tasks from the command line. When you add a task, it gets saved to a file on your disk so it stays there even after you close the program.
explanations.intermediate: The recipe combines `otter-official/file-helpers` for JSON persistence with `otter-official/text-utils` for padded column formatting. State is represented as a list of Task objects, serialized to disk on mutation.
explanations.advanced: Implements an ACID-like file save pattern using `writeSafe`. Tasks are held in an in-memory list of typed objects and persisted as JSON. Column formatting uses deterministic spacing.
